passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing true damage each second.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
spells.tooltip:
Twitch Camouflages and gains {{ movespeedmod }}% Move Speed for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. The Move Speed increases to {{ hiddenspeed }}% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.

When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
spells.tooltip:
Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for {{ duration }} seconds.

Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by {{ totalslowamount }}% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
spells.tooltip:
Deals {{ basedamage }} physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional {{ physicaldamageperstack }} physical damage and {{ magicdamageperstack }} magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom.

Max Damage: {{ maxphysicaldamage }} physical damage and {{ maxmagicdamage }} magical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
spells.tooltip:
Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining {{ bonusrange }} Attack Range and {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for {{ duration }} seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal {{ falloffdamage*100 }}% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ minimumfalloffdamage*100 }}% damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Deadly Venom
effects: Innate: Twitch's basic attacks on-hit apply a stack of Deadly Venom for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 6 times.

Deadly Venom: For each stack, the target is dealt[ 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on level) (+ 3% AP) true damage per second over the duration, ][ 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) total true damage over the duration, ]for a maximum of[ 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (based on level) (+ 18% AP) true damage with each tick. ][ 36 / 72 / 108 / 144 / 180 (based on level) (+ 108% AP) total true damage over the duration. ]This effect is considered a poison.

variants.name: Ambush
effects: During this time, Twitch gains 10% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing enemy champions within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.
When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Deadly Venom, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

variants.name: Venom Cask
effects: Active: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes at the target location, applying Deadly Venom to enemies hit and granting sight of the area.

variants.name: Contaminate
effects: A nearby enemy with Deadly Venom is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

variants.name: Spray and Pray
effects: The bolts deal 100% : 60% (based on enemies hit) of the triggering attack's damage, apply on-hit effects, and can critically strike for (175% + 40%) damage.

changes.title: E - Contaminate
changes.text: QoL Adjustment : If Twitch uses his E at the same time his poison expires on an enemy, they will now take damage based on the number of stacks they had when the poison expired. This should result in the E cast being just slightly more forgiving.

changes.title: E - Contaminate
changes.text: Magic Damage per Stack : 35% AP ⇒ 30% AP

changes.title: Passive - Deadly Venom
changes.text: Damage Per Stack : 1/2/3/4/5 (based on level) (+ 2.5% AP) ⇒ 1/2/3/4/5 (based on level) (+ 3% AP)

changes.title: E - Contaminate
changes.text: Magic Damage per Stack : (+ 33% AP) ⇒ (+ 35% AP)

changes.title: R - Spray and Pray
changes.text: updated LONGER PINS AND LONGER NEEDLES: The extra distance that Twitch's bolts travel now scales with his bonus attack range

changes.title: Passive - Deadly Venom
changes.text: DAMAGE RATIO PER STACK: 3% AP ⇒ 2.5% AP

changes.title: P - Deadly Venom
changes.text: new DAMAGE RATIO: 3% AP damage per second, per stack (max 108% AP for 6 stacks over 6 seconds)

changes.title: E - Contaminate
changes.text: AP SCALING DAMAGE: 33.3% AP physical damage per Deadly Poison stack (max 200% AP for 6 stacks) ⇒ 33.3% AP magic damage per Deadly Poison stack (max 200% AP for 6 stacks)

changes.title: E - Contaminate
changes.text: BONUS DAMAGE PER STACK RATIO: 0.2 ability power (maximum 1.2 ability power) ⇒ 0.333 ability power (maximum 2.0 ability power)

changes.title: R - Spray And Pray
changes.text: BOLT DAMAGE REDUCTION PER ENEMY HIT: -20% from the previous hit (minimum damage cap of 40%) ⇒ -10% per unit hit (minimum damage cap of 60%)
